applies_to: Belimo PR rotary actuators for butterfly valves in the BACnet MS/TP version (PR..-BAC-..).
summary: The PR..-BAC-.. is a Belimo rotary actuator for butterfly valves with BACnet MS/TP on board. The BMS writes a % setpoint to AO 1 (0 up to the Max limit in AV 98) and reads position and status; two sensor inputs can be read over the bus. The setpoint can also come from a 0-10 V signal, chosen with SpSource.
notes: AbsPos reads in degrees on rotary actuators and mm on linear ones; degrees shown.
Sensor analog values (AI 20/21) are in V, ohm, °C or °F depending on the sensor type, so no unit is shown.
Sensor objects and the analog setpoint go Out_Of_Service when they do not apply to the selected sensor type or setpoint source.
StatusActuator states marked * in the PICS (actuator cannot move, travel increased) stay set until reset with Command (MV 120) = Reset.

source.title: BACnet PICS, Butterfly Valve Actuator PR..-BAC-..

integration.summary: Leave MV 122 SpSource at Bus (the default) and command AO 1 SpRel. Read AI 1 position and BI 101 summary status. If a bus watchdog is set in AV 130, keep writing AO 1 (or MO 1) within that time.

minimum_points.name: SpSource
minimum_points.why: Must be Bus for AO 1 to take effect

integration.enable: MV 122 SpSource selects the setpoint: Bus (2, default) uses AO 1; Analog (1) follows the 0-10 V signal on wire 3. MO 1 Override can force Open, Close or a fixed Min/Mid/Max position.
integration.heartbeat: AV 130 Bus Watchdog (0-3600 s, default 0 = off). When set, each write to AO 1 or MO 1 restarts the timer; on timeout the AO 1 priority array is cleared, the relinquish default applies, and MI 110 shows Bus Watchdog triggered. With SpSource = Analog only MO 1 writes are tracked.
setup: Max 32 nodes without repeater; a 120 ohm termination is built in and set with the configuration tool (BI 99 shows it).
Configure with the Belimo Assistant App.
gotchas: Persistent writable objects are not meant to be written on a regular basis.
AO 1 is limited to 0 up to Max (AV 98, 30-100 %, default 100).
Max 6 active COV subscriptions, lifetime up to 8 hours.
